neighbours.label: ' another' closing the idiom 'one way/time/point or another', as opposed to ' another' meaning one more or a different one
fire: Most families have struggled with money at one point or another.
Every engineer makes that mistake at one stage or another.
The project will be finished one way or another by Friday.
Nearly all of us have been late for work at one time or another.
She promised to get the money back one way or another.
Each of these kings fought the empire at one time or another.
We will find out the truth one way or another.
Almost every town in the valley has flooded at some point or another.
quiet: Most families have struggled with money at another point in their lives.
Every engineer makes that mistake on another project later.
The project will be finished by another team on Friday.
Nearly all of us have been late for work more than once.
She promised to get the money back from another bank.
Each of these kings fought another empire in the east.
We will find out the truth in another week.
Almost every town in the valley has flooded at least once.
